difficulty_reason: Ext vanishing bands for a perfect K against bounded QCoh L: identifies Ext^i(K, L) = H^i(X, K^vee ⊗ L) via the dual perfect complex, checks P = K^vee ⊗ L is in D_QCoh, runs the spectral sequence E_1^{p,q} = H^p(K^vee ⊗ H^q(L)) to get vanishing of H^j when H^q(L) = 0 on [j-b, j-a], and finishes with the cohomological-dimension bound N of the vanishing lemma plus lemma-application-nice-K-injective: H^0(X, -) only sees tau_{>= -N}, whose terms vanish, so Hom(K, L) = 0 for H^i(L) = 0 on [-b-N, -a].
